description: Source code for the DHCPv6 client service, including functions for starting, stopping, updating, and handling system events related to DHCPv6 client management.

methods.name: dbusInit
methods.description: Initializes the D-Bus connection for system communication.

methods.name: remove_file
methods.description: Removes a specified file if it exists.

methods.name: copy_command_output
methods.description: Executes a shell command and copies its output to a buffer.

methods.name: dhcpv6_client_service_start
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv6 client service based on system state and configuration.

methods.name: dhcpv6_client_service_stop
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv6 client service and cleans up related processes and files.

methods.name: dhcpv6_client_service_update
methods.description: Updates the DHCPv6 client service based on current system events and configuration.

methods.name: register_sysevent_handler
methods.description: Registers a system event handler for DHCPv6 client events.

methods.name: unregister_sysevent_handler
methods.description: Unregisters a system event handler for DHCPv6 client events.

methods.name: register_dhcpv6_client_handler
methods.description: Registers all relevant system event handlers for DHCPv6 client management.

methods.name: unregister_dhcpv6_client_handler
methods.description: Unregisters all system event handlers related to DHCPv6 client management.

methods.name: dhcpv6_client_service_enable
methods.description: Enables the DHCPv6 client service and registers event handlers.

methods.name: dhcpv6_client_service_disable
methods.description: Disables the DHCPv6 client service and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: sysevent_syscfg_init
methods.description: Initializes system event and configuration interface.
